_doc: Skill-trigger cases for `eng-os eval --skills`. Each prompt runs in a fresh one-turn `claude -p` session in an empty folder, with eng-os installed. A positive case passes when Claude calls the Skill tool with that skill; a negative case passes when it does not. Five positives and one negative per model-invoked skill (method from modelcontextprotocol/servers docs/skill-authoring.md). User-invoked skills (eng-os-review) are not listed. Keep prompts generic: no project, client or server names.
